courses.title: South Baltic Exercise Oncology Academy
courses.description: Six online modules for physiotherapists, nurses and physicians who are new to exercise in cancer care. Training cycle 1 starts in February 2028.

courses.title: The AMBeR model in five phases
courses.description: A short introduction to the AMBeR implementation model, from needs assessment to evaluation.

courses.title: Your first digital exercise consultation
courses.description: Practical preparation: equipment, the room, safety and what to say to the patient.

courses.title: Test and learn several times
courses.description: How to try a small change, see what happens and decide what to do next.

courses.title: Slides: Exercise during cancer treatment
courses.description: Course material for module 1 of the Academy.

courses.title: Handout: Safety checklist before an exercise session
courses.description: One page to print and keep in the clinic.

courses.title: Reading list: exercise oncology
courses.description: Guidelines and review articles chosen by the Academy teachers.

facilitatorMaterials.title: Practice Lab facilitator guide
facilitatorMaterials.description: How to prepare and lead a 45-minute online case discussion.

facilitatorMaterials.title: Session plan template
facilitatorMaterials.description: Plan with times, questions and tasks for one Academy session.

facilitatorMaterials.title: Example cases for discussion
facilitatorMaterials.description: Five invented patient cases. They contain no real patient data.

facilitatorMaterials.title: Feedback form for participants
facilitatorMaterials.description: Five short questions to ask after each session.

experiences.text: First Practice Lab: eight participants from four countries. One case was enough for 45 minutes. Next time I will send the case two days before.
Second Practice Lab: it helped to ask each person one direct question. Quiet participants said more when we used the chat first.

submissions.text: We need simple exercise instructions for patients with lung cancer who become short of breath quickly.
Could nurses give patients a card with a QR code to the exercise programme at the first chemotherapy visit?
We would like an example of how to calculate staff time for digital group sessions.
Let patients who have finished the programme record a short greeting to new patients.
submissions.response: Thank you. We have passed your idea to the team that works on the introduction video for patients.

submissions.text: Where can I read about when exercise is not recommended during cancer treatment?
submissions.response: Thank you for your question. The open platform has a reading list under Learnings & resources, and the Academy covers this in module 1.
